name: AI-based populating of knowledge base through past support tickets
description:
This recipe helps to create or update a page in the knowledge base in Notion by taking in approved resolution for issues from Jira. Once the approved checkbox is checked, it passes the issue description and issue resolution to a callable recipe function which uses OpenAI to format it into a question, answer and usable tags for enhanced searching in the database.

Notion provides a centralised platform to store and organise your questions and answers. With the tags, you can easily categorise and filter the search results, making it easy to locate and retrieve information when needed.

Notion is accessible on various platforms, including web browsers, desktop applications, and mobile devices. This cross-platform compatibility ensures that your knowledge base is accessible anytime, anywhere, and on different devices, allowing for seamless information retrieval and updates.
